description: Pergélisol au Nunavik is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Le pergélisol correspond à tout sol ou roc dont la température se maintient sous 0°C depuis des années. Dans l’extrême nord du territoire québécois, il est omniprésent et très épais. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are Affaissements, Arctique, Caractéristiques géocryologiques, Caractéristiques thermiques, Facteurs de risque. It offers 9 resource(s) in GEOTIFF, HTML, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
